    "for name, arr in variables.items():\n",

    "    print(\"P10:\", np.percentile(arr, 10))\n",
    "    print(\"P50:\", np.percentile(arr, 50))\n",
    "    print(\"P90:\", np.percentile(arr, 90))\n",
    "    print()"
   ]

   "source": [
    "w_c_ratio = variables['water'] / variables['cement']\n",
    "\n",
    "print(\"W/C Ratio Statistics:\")\n",
    "print(\"Mean:\", np.mean(w_c_ratio))\n",
    "print(\"Min:\", np.min(w_c_ratio))\n",
    "print(\"Max:\", np.max(w_c_ratio))"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "code",

   "metadata": {},
   "outputs": [],
   "source": [
    "low_wc = np.sum(w_c_ratio < 0.4)\n",
    "mid_wc = np.sum((w_c_ratio >= 0.4) & (w_c_ratio <= 0.6))\n",
    "high_wc = np.sum(w_c_ratio > 0.6)\n",
    "\n",
    "print(\"W/C < 0.4:\", low_wc)\n",
    "print(\"0.4 to 0.6:\", mid_wc)\n",
    "print(\"W/C > 0.6:\", high_wc)\n"
   ]
  },
